title: Failure to comply with summons or citation.
bodyText: If a violator of this part does not return an answer in response to a summons or citation within a period of fourteen days upon receipt of the summons or citation, the traffic, emergency period, and fireworks violations bureau shall issue to the registered owner of the vehicle a penal summons ordering the registered owner's appearance in court.
bodyHtml: §291C-225  Failure to comply with summons or citation.  If a violator of this part does not return an answer in response to a summons or citation within a period of fourteen days upon receipt of the summons or citation, the traffic, emergency period, and fireworks violations bureau shall issue to the registered owner of the vehicle a penal summons ordering the registered owner's appearance in court. [L 1993, c 224, pt of §1, §6; am L 1995, c 25, §1; am L 1997, c 309, §4; am L 2021, c 185, §17; am L 2025, c 243, §35]
